lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A repeating rectilinear matrix of high-luminance circular clusters is observed posterior to the branchial region, arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows and vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating a grid-like lattice structure most visible in the central flank area.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient from high luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

other_distinctive_markers: Small remora attached to the upper flank above the third gill slit; pectoral fin displays a high density of smaller high-luminance spots compared to the lateral flank pattern.
